description: UX A2: operator commands. alice (admin, windowed F2F) and bob (windowed F2F) + carol (protocol), real olife-sandboxd, samples bmob1/bmob2 (bob) and cmob (carol) running demo_orbit. Non-admin refusals (bob /kill from the chat window -> 16 + refuse sound; carol /freeze 16, /blah 17, /mobs only hers); /mobs bob; freeze/unfreeze a mob (world stops it, bob's tag FROZEN, Notice + fx_freeze); /limits bob fuel 20000 + bucket 0 -> sandboxd set_limits for bob's owner, sandbox throttles, tag THROTTLED, Notice; defaults back; per-mob actions 0 (world-side); CLI (olife.op via=cli) and panel (POST /call/olife.op via=panel); /tp; /kill and /killall; /kick bob (Disconnect 10, fx kicked); /ban carol (Disconnect 5, re-login refused), /unban; audit.jsonl has every command, refusals and via chat/cli/panel; op lines in chat.
